programs.name: 5/3/1 for Beginners
programs.description: Wendler's classic strength template. Three days a week, one main lift per day working up to a heavy top set, plus light accessory work.

programs.name: Full Body Beginner
programs.description: A simple StrongLifts-style full body split for your first months of lifting. Squat every session, alternate upper body pushing and pulling.

programs.name: Upper/Lower 4-Day
programs.description: A four day upper/lower split balancing pressing, pulling and lower body volume for steady strength gains.

programs.name: Push Pull Legs
programs.description: A six day push/pull/legs split run twice a week, built for hypertrophy with higher exercise volume per muscle group.

programs.name: GZCLP
programs.description: Cody LeFever's linear progression program. Four days a week pairing a heavy Tier 1 lift with moderate Tier 2 and light Tier 3 accessory work.
